boundary: Original bytes from completed desktop runs only. Packaging performs no product test, GUI action, fixture mutation, or current repository/binary check. No whole-task or milestone completion is asserted.

C01StageStay.scope: Window-close ask, Stay, explicit delivery, remained open.

C02UnstageStay.scope: Successful Git result captured, then Cmd-Q exited before result delivery. Not evidence that Git was killed or data was lost.

R07OldRead01.scope: Historical held-read/review observations; not a new-version rerun or complete task07 acceptance.

B10C01StageStay.scope: Window-close ask, Stay, explicit delivery, remained open.

B10C02UnstageStay.scope: Real Cmd-Q ask, Stay, explicit delivery, remained open.

B10C03DockWait.scope: Dock tool timed out; Dock Quit was never executed. explicit:false automatic delivery is not an explicit-release, Dock Quit, or Wait pass.

B10C04MenuWait.scope: Native Quit menu, Wait, explicit delivery, then exit 0.

B10C05RestorePending.scope: Earlier restore confirmation was not approved; no restore command ran. Permissions were restored. This is not the later approved sample.

B10C05ApprovedPending.scope: Approved real restore preparation failed before any path write; Close/Wait, explicit error delivery, pending blocked auto-close, Stay, then separately authorized final acknowledgement on a new Close led to exit 0.

B10C06SaveAsStay.scope: Native Save As to a new path succeeded and Cmd-Q ask/Stay was observed. Delivery timed out automatically (explicit:false); not an explicit-release Stay pass.

font-shortcuts.scope: Font decrease/save observed; font increase is not verified. Repeated plus-key names do not prove DOM plus-key delivery.

review-persistence-observations.scope: Preserved startup review-mark observation; not a complete task07 acceptance verdict.

review-recovery-observations.scope: Preserved restart, shell-error, readonly/recovery, and external-edit observations; no expanded acceptance verdict is generated by archival.

exclusionBoundary: The entire fixtureRoot (including its real repo, .git, home and revia-data) was excluded before traversal. Only separately recorded snapshot worktree/data directories are included.

knownLimitations.SCOPED_SAMPLE_ONLY: Pass labels are limited to each sample catalog scope; error outcomes may be the expected error-handling case. Error, partial, invalid and not-executed observations are not dropped or promoted.
knownLimitations.SNAPSHOT_HISTORY_NOT_REEXECUTION: Later data snapshots contain prior-PID claimed/captured/release/delivered markers and recovery records. embeddedRecordRun identifies known marker ownership; copying a historical marker never counts as a new action on the snapshot PID.
knownLimitations.CUA_TRANSCRIPT_GAP: No complete raw CUA request/response transcript was supplied. PNG/AX, identity records, action/verdict notes and process logs remain distinct. Missing PNG/identity companions were not fabricated.
knownLimitations.FONT_INCREASE_UNVERIFIED: Font decrease/save and restart observations do not prove the increase shortcut. The original plus-key observations are preserved without blind repair or a passing increase claim.
knownLimitations.DOCK_SAMPLE_INVALID: B10C03DockWait did not execute Dock Quit and delivered with explicit:false. It is not an explicit-release, Dock Quit or Wait pass.
knownLimitations.SAVE_AS_PARTIAL: B10C06SaveAsStay created a new output file successfully, but automatic 300-second release means the hold/release part is partial.
knownLimitations.C05_GENERATIONS_SEPARATE: The earlier C05-not-executed sample remains not-executed. The later B10C05ApprovedPending sample has its own approved action, explicit delivery, pending/Stay, final user acknowledgement and exit record. Earlier intermediate boundaries are historical, not rewritten current verdicts.
knownLimitations.OLD_EXIT_FAILURE_RETAINED: Old 5f exitCode 0 is still a C02 safety failure because it occurred before result release. It does not imply Git was killed or file data was lost.
knownLimitations.NO_MILESTONE_COMPLETION: This archive does not independently establish remaining task05/07/08/12/13, CI, D06 or Q98 gates.
knownLimitations.IMAGE_EXTENSION_MISMATCH: The 31 original screenshot filenames end in .png but their original byte signatures identify JPEG. Their names and bytes are preserved without transcoding or renaming. This packaging fact is recorded, not treated as a product defect.

recordedByteComparisons.basis: Only the preserved snapshots and metadata were compared; no live fixture or current binary/source was read.
